newsitem.title: USA: Key Plastics Inc sells $125 mln in 144A notes.
newsitem.headline: Key Plastics Inc sells $125 mln in 144A notes.

text.p: The following issue from Key Plastics Inc was priced on Wednesday in the 144A private placement market via Lehman Brothers, according to market sources.
Key Plastics is a global supplier of engineered plastic components and assemblies to the automotive industry.
